actual: Simplify AIstock documentation handling into three tiers: docs-fast-update, docs-fast-new, and docs-controlled. Ordinary docs should require only a worktree, version/change note, PR, and minimal diff check; strict workflow/standards/agent docs keep full guardrails.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
